summary: Held the entire 15-frame window. Price moved favorably early (peaked +16.25pts) and, despite several pullbacks (one brief -3.5pt dip at frame 3, one near-flat -0.75pt dip at frame 13), never showed a sustained break into negative territory relative to the trade's own amplitude (~20-27pt legs) -- each dip was reclaimed within 1-2 frames, consistent with normal chop rather than a wrong-direction reversal. Closed the window at +7.50pts favorable. Next time I'd watch for: a dip that fails to reclaim prior favorable territory within 2-3 frames, or px going net negative concurrently with multiple against-fires stacking (frame 12 had two against-fires but px stayed positive, which is why I didn't bail) -- that combination would be the real wrong-direction tell.
